text: Walmart Q2 revenue rose 5.9% to $187.94 billion and global e-commerce grew 232%. U.S. comparable sales rose 2.6%. Walmart received about $2.8 billion of $2.9 billion in eligible tariff refunds, while global inventory increased 6.7%.

meta.note: Tariff refunds affect gross profit while health-and-wellness price caps weigh on U.S. comparable sales.
